compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Eight storage-maintenance verbs (`fsck`, `fsck-recover`, `doctor`, `tracker-maintenance`, `tracker-footprint`, `export`, `import`, `compact`/`compact-all`) sit at top level with a redundant `tracker-` prefix and a `compact`/`compact-all` pair. They have four different init policies, so a group cannot be a single route with one `init`. Operator decision: hard cutover into `rebar store <sub>` with removed-name hints. Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
(1) `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py`: new `STORE_ROUTES: tuple[Route, ...]` (member `Route`s named `fsck fsck-recover doctor maintenance footprint export import compact`, `group="store"`, each keeping its current `parser_factory`, `handler`, `adapter`, `init`, `no_auto_mount`; `compact` gets `handler="rebar._commands.compact:compact_dispatch_cli"`, factory `rebar._cli._parsers.core.compact:build_compact`); one top-level `Route("store", group="store", parser_factory="rebar._cli._parsers.advanced.store:build", handler="rebar._cli._store_commands:store_cli", adapter="argv", init="none")`; delete the 9 top-level routes (`:297-336`, `:555-586`, `:491-502`), leaving `reclaim-collapse` at `:313-320` intact; drop `compact` and `io` from `_GROUP_TO_SET`. (2) `_execute.execute(name, rest, *, routes=ROUTES)` passes `routes` to `route_for` (`:31`). (3) New `src/rebar/_cli/_store_commands.py` (about 100 LOC): no sub prints usage to stderr and exits 2; unknown sub gives argparse invalid-choice via the `advanced/store.py` parser, exit 2; `wants_help(rest)` renders `factory(prog=f"rebar store {sub}").format_help()` and exits 0; otherwise `_execute.execute(sub, rest, routes=STORE_ROUTES)`. (4) `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/store.py` copied from `audit.py:18-39` with the 8 subparsers. (5) `_help_route._NESTED_INTERCEPTS:38-40` add `"store"`; `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py:_store_mount_eligible:41-62` add `if sub == "store" and len(argv) > 1 and argv[1] == "footprint": return False` beside the `config validate` carve-out at `:58` (`tracker-footprint` is `no_auto_mount=True`, pinned by `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py:109-116`, to re-target). (6) `src/rebar/_parsers/core/compact.py`: rename `build_compact` to `build_compact_one`; new `build_compact` (help-facing) = one-flags plus `--all` plus all-flags marked "(with --all)"; keep `build_compact_all`; new `compact_dispatch_cli(argv)` in `src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`: `--all` before `--` delegates to `compact_all_cli(argv minus --all)`; `--dry-run/--limit/--include-archived` without `--all` exits 2; else `compact_cli(argv)` (`:74`, parsing with `build_compact_one`, `prog="rebar store compact"`); `:530` prog becomes `rebar store compact --all`. (7) `_help_route._REMOVED_SPELLINGS` gains the 9 entries. (8) `.github/workflows/compact-sweep.yml:153` invokes `rebar store compact --all` (`pip install -e .` at `:85`, so the same-change edit is atomic). (9) In-source user-facing strings `rebar fsck|doctor|fsck-recover|compact|tracker-maintenance|export` (21/20/11/8/5/7 hits, e.g. `src/rebar/_commands/fsck_tracker_health.py`, `src/rebar/_engine_support/validate.py`, `src/rebar/_snapshot/gc_trigger.py`, `src/rebar/_io/_cli.py` prog strings) become the new spellings; `examples/mcp-clients/{claude/.mcp.json:12,codex/config.toml:13,copilot/mcp-config.json:12}` and `AGENTS.md:258` are handled by the docs story. (10) Regenerate help and reference; `docs/exit-codes.md` rows `:136,137,144-147,177,180,184` become `store fsck` etc. (a row may begin with `store`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes.py:283-298`); `docs/user-guide.md:600`; `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py:52-65,109-116`, `tests/unit/test_cli_registry_dispatch.py:168-196`, `_CENSUS_SETS`; `scripts/probe_rebar.py:518,625,627`; a new unit test asserting `validate(STORE_ROUTES) == ()` and member-name uniqueness.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_cli/{_registry,_execute,_help_route,__init__}.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_store_commands.py` (new), `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/store.py` (new), `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/compact.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`, in-source hint strings (files from `git grep -n -E "rebar (fsck|doctor|fsck-recover|compact|tracker-maintenance|tracker-footprint|export|import)" -- src/rebar ':!src/rebar/_cli/help'`), `.github/workflows/compact-sweep.yml`, help and reference, gated docs, tests. Out of scope: `reclaim-collapse`, `scratch`, `delete`.

## Testing
`rebar fsck` and the other 8 old spellings exit 2 with the hint; `rebar store` exits 2 with usage; `rebar store --help` equals the committed `help/store.txt`; `rebar store fsck --help` renders `build_fsck(prog="rebar store fsck")` help and exits 0; `rebar store doctor --repair` applies init `doctor` with `init_only=False` (monkeypatch `rebar._cli.ensure_initialized` as in `test_cli_registry_dispatch.py`); `rebar store footprint` does not trigger the central mount (extend `test_central_mount_gate_ad9f`); `rebar store compact --all --dry-run --output json` bytes equal old `compact-all`; `rebar store compact <id> --dry-run` exits 2; `rebar store fsck --output json` bytes equal old `fsck --output json` (existing goldens re-targeted). `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `route_for(x) is None` for the 9 old spellings and `main([x])` exits 2 with the hint (parametrized test).
- [ ] `STORE_ROUTES` validates clean and every member's handler and factory resolve (`tests/unit/test_cli_registry_full_extra.py` pattern applied to `STORE_ROUTES`).
- [ ] Each member runs under its own init policy, asserted per member with the init spy.
- [ ] `compact-sweep.yml` invokes `rebar store compact --all`; `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check`, the exit-code doc tests, and `scripts/probe_rebar.py` are green.
- [ ] JSON output of every member is byte-identical to its pre-move golden.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
compiled_state.title: Move the nine storage-maintenance verbs under `rebar store` with per-member init policies and removed-name hints
